reader.requirement: At --std 85 every execution of an OPEN on a relative file, successful or not, updates the file's I-O status to the VIII.1.3.4 value for its outcome: 00, 05 (absent optional), 35 (absent non-optional INPUT/I-O/EXTEND), 37, 38 (closed with lock), 39 (attribute conflict), 41 (already open), and never a status the 1985 list lacks (no 61).

edition-consulted.switches: host sharing refusal answers 30 at 85 (SharingFacilityInEffect false), 61 from 2002
Table 19 61 only when FileSharingFacility is active (2002+)
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: at 85 the physical file is locked (38 through any file-name), from 2002 the file connector
passes ctx.Data.DialectLevel as the relative connector's Edition

reader.edition-search: grep of Runtime/IO for SharingFacilityInEffect|DialectBehavior|Edition, and of the emitter for EditionArg/DialectLevel on RegisterRelative.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 no OPEN answers 61 (a sharing conflict is 30) and CLOSE WITH LOCK locks the physical file; the per-outcome status values this rule updates are otherwise the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_status_updated drives 00/41/35/05 on SEQUENTIAL files only; no relative-file OPEN status, and not 37, 38 or 39

reader.notes: OpenOnceEntered ends with Status = s on every path and EmitOpen stores the FILE STATUS item after each file's OPEN, before its USE hook. The 85 arms (no 61, physical-file lock for 38) are each what the 1985 text asks.

refuter.evidence: Checked the 1985 relative status list (VIII.1.3.4: 00 02 04 05 30 35 37 38 39 41-49 9x, no 61). Probes: runs/r16_ro-001 OUTPUT/EXTEND/I-O on a read-only file each 37 with the USE procedure entered after the status was stored; runs/r17_useopen-001 a 35 then a 41 within one OPEN, each stored before its USE ran; runs/r18_implicit-001 39 on EXTEND and on random I-O.
